title: Farzando ke Lasho Pe Ye Maa Karti Thi Zaari
body:
Farzandaon ke lashaon pe yeh maa kartithi zaari aye aun-o-mohammed, sehre bhi na bandhe gaye duniya se main waari aye
Aun-o-mohammed
Armaan yeh tha dono ka main byaah karoongi rahat se rahoongi, kuch bas na chala mera muqaddar se main waari ayeaun-o-mohammed
Do laashey nazaraate hain do dulhaon ke badle maa tum pa ho sadqe, kin aankhaon se ab dekhoon mein haalath yeh tumhari aye aun-omohammed
<<DIVIDER>>
Main maa hoon mere aage janazey hain tumhare kya dil mera maane, sar peet ke kyon kar na karoon girya-o-zaari aye aun-o-mohammed
Mamoo ka to haq tum ne ada kardiya pyaaro par yeh to bata do , kya maa nathi haq daar mohabbat mein tumhari aye aun-o-mohammed
Baqer yahi lashaon pa buka karti thi madar sadqe gayi tum par, tum dono ne is waqt rakhi sharm hamari aye aun-o-mohammed..
